say:1:1320726001:0.text: That was great! When I first came here, I got caught in a snowstorm and nearly became a popsicle. Gerda had to kick me into the hot spring to thaw me out!
say:1:1320726001:0.source_cn: 不错的体验吧！我刚到这里的时候遭遇了暴风雪，差点被冻成...
say:1:1320726001:0.male: That was great! When I first came here, I got caught in a snowstorm and nearly became a popsicle. Gerda had to kick me into the hot spring to thaw me out!
say:1:1320726001:0.female: That was great! When I first came here, I got caught in a snowstorm and nearly became a popsicle. Gerda had to kick me into the hot spring to thaw me out!

say:2:1320726002:0.text: ...Though I almost drowned in the process.
say:2:1320726002:0.source_cn: 虽然我当时差点被温泉水呛死……
say:2:1320726002:0.male: ...Though I almost drowned in the process.
say:2:1320726002:0.female: ...Though I almost drowned in the process.

say:3:1320726003:1.text: Anyway, don't stand out in the cold for too long. Change into something warm before you catch a chill.
say:3:1320726003:1.source_cn: 啊，你别在冷风里站着，快去换回厚衣服，小心着凉。
say:3:1320726003:1.male: Anyway, don't stand out in the cold for too long. Change into something warm before you catch a chill.
say:3:1320726003:1.female: Anyway, don't stand out in the cold for too long. Change into something warm before you catch a chill.

say:4:1320726004:1.text: Once you're ready, let's head back to the inn.
say:4:1320726004:1.source_cn: 等你换好衣服，我们直接回旅店吧。
say:4:1320726004:1.male: Once you're ready, let's head back to the inn.
